title: awa-lasvegas-2005-world-heavyweight
label: Cody Carson

won.source: Blood Is Thicker Than Water: announced 'our New AWA World Champion... Cody Carson' after the ladder-billed main event.

how: Beat Mike Young in the main event.
note: Later roleplays call him World champion; no loss survives.

title: awa-lasvegas-2005-world-heavyweight
label: Mike Young

won.source: Billed World champion on Blood Is Thicker Than Water; no won-date survives.

how: Lost the World title to Cody Carson in the main event of Blood Is Thicker Than Water.

title: awa-lasvegas-2005-continental
label: Michael Manson

won.source: Blood Is Thicker Than Water: Cody Carson hands Manson the Continental title after the pinfall.

how: Beat Derek Cantina at Blood Is Thicker Than Water.
note: By 19 November 2005 Johnny Arnette is champion; how Manson's reign ended is not in the record.

won.source: Adrenaline: announced 'NEW AWA Continental CHAMPION... The Rumbler' after Jimmy Stryker, the guest referee, counts the three.

title: awa-lasvegas-2005-continental
label: Derek Cantina

won.source: Champion going into Blood Is Thicker Than Water (Cody Carson tells him he stands to lose 'your singles title'); no won-date survives.

how: Lost the Continental title to teammate Michael Manson at Blood Is Thicker Than Water.

title: awa-lasvegas-2005-continental
label: Johnny Arnette

won.source: Billed Continental champion at Adrenaline on 19 November 2005; no won-date survives.

how: Lost to The Rumbler at Adrenaline.
note: The card's announcer reads his billing as the 'RWA Continental Champion'; the match is announced as for the AWA Continental Championship.

title: awa-lasvegas-2005-chaos
label: The Rumbler

won.source: Blood Is Thicker Than Water: announced 'your AWA Chaos Champion, The Rumbler' after the hardcore match.

how: Beat J Sane in the hardcore Chaos title match.
note: No earlier holder and no loss survive; the later card's commentary says of his Continental win that 'the kid finally tastes gold.'

title: awa-lasvegas-2005-unified
label: Simon Sensation

won.source: Blood Is Thicker Than Water: announced 'New Unified Champion Simon Sensation.'

how: Beat Angela Jameson in a finisher-only unification match.

title: awa-lasvegas-2005-fem-x
label: Brandi James

won.source: Billed Fem-X champion on Blood Is Thicker Than Water; her own pages say she won it in her first AWA match; no date survives.

how: Standing champion on Blood Is Thicker Than Water.
note: Her own page header says she never acknowledges the title.

title: awa-lasvegas-2005-fem-x
label: Skylar Black

won.source: Called the Fem-X champion by the commentary after her win at Adrenaline on 19 November 2005; the card does not name the match a title match.

note: Her later roleplays call her the Fem-X champion and a former champion.
